test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct verb form to complete the sentence from the passage.

"This ecosystem ______ produced over a hundred unicorns, startups valued at over one billion dollars."
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ***Option 1: has***

 
 
• The subject of the sentence is **"This ecosystem"**.
 
• The word "ecosystem" is a **singular noun**. In English grammar, a third-person singular subject requires the auxiliary verb **"has"** to form the Present Perfect Tense<
